messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: ALARM - euc2 ingress 5xx spike - threshold exceeded on per-region LB (5xx rate 18% over 5m). Alert ID: LB-ALARM-2073.
Kate (on-call): on it, paging SRE. grabbing threads and initial metrics.
Kate (on-call): @Priya are you around? seeing big 5xx surge in euc2, looks like connreset flood from envoy.
Priya (SRE): here — thanks. can you dump the ingress proxy logs and target health? I’ll start root cause triage.
Kate (on-call): attaching quick sample from envoy error logs:
```
[2026-03-15T10:12:34Z] envoy upstream reset: connection_failure, downstream_remote_reset, total_retries_exceeded
[2026-03-15T10:12:36Z] upstream 10.1.12.45: upstream connection reset by peer
```
Priya (SRE): ok that matches NLB/ALB target resets. pulling target group metrics: target healthy count dropping in euc2b AZ. average connect time spiking.
Alex (infra): I’m seeing increased SYN_RECV and connection resets on the euc2b NAT/ENI. Could be noisy NIC or AZ-level networking degradation. AWS Console shows elevated path errors for euc2b.
Marta (support): any customer-facing impact yet? CS reporting an uptick in support tickets for timeouts.
Kate (on-call): yes several customers from EU region reporting 502/504. tagging on status page. ETA unknown.
Priya (SRE): immediate plan: 1) reduce traffic weight to euc2b via Route53 weighted policy; 2) mark unhealthy targets in ALB to stop routing; 3) add temporary NLB fallback for critical routes if ALB health unstable; 4) increase ingress replicas in euc2 to reduce per-pod load. Doing 1 and 2 now.
Kate (on-call): executing route53 weight change (low TTL) — snippet used:
```
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z12345 --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.redwood.example","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"euc2b","Weight":1,"TTL":30,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"54.12.34.56"}]}}]}'
```
Priya (SRE): ALB target deregistration started for problem instances. healthchecks failing now -> ALB will stop routing to those targets.
Deploy Bot: Deploy succeeded: ingress-restart v3.2.1 on euc2 (2 pods restarted).
Alex (infra): pushing a quick kernel-level knob to reduce TIME_WAIT accumulation on nodes while we stabilize:
```
echo 1 > /proc/sys/net/ipv4/tcp_tw_reuse
```
Priya (SRE): also adjusting Envoy upstream_keepalive to 30s and lowering max connections per upstream to avoid head-of-line amplification. applying config patch now.
Kate (on-call): reached out to AWS support — raising an AZ network degradation ticket, reference case #CASE-2073-AZB.
Priya (SRE): traffic to euc2b is ~5% of regional traffic now, overall 5xx rate dropping to 3% over last 2m. still seeing intermittent resets but improved.
Marta (support): posted initial status to customers: short blip causing errors for some EU users, mitigation in progress. link: https://status.redwood.example/incident/2073
Priya (SRE): running a canary sweep against a healthy AZ target group (euc2a) — latency and error rates back to normal there. will leave euc2b heavily de-weighted until AWS confirms network recovery.
Kate (on-call): brief customer impact summary for pager: duration ~12m of elevated 5xx, affected ~25% of EU-region requests (concentrated to euc2b), partial mitigation applied (traffic shifted, targets drained).
Alex (infra): also saw autoscaling not trigger fast enough for ALB->ingress path due to mutual TLS handshake backlog. opened follow-up ticket to tune ASG scalePolicy cooldowns.
Priya (SRE): next steps: keep euc2b at low weight, monitor for 30m, coordinate with AWS to root cause, schedule postmortem with infra and SRE.
Kate (on-call): handing off to Priya for the overnight watch. summary for handoff:
- incident root: AZ-level network errors causing ALB/NLB target resets and Envoy upstream connection resets
- mitigation taken: Route53 weight shift, ALB target drain, Envoy config tweak, increased ingress pods, kernel knobs, AWS case opened
- customer impact: transient 5xx spike, some customers saw timeouts; status page updated
- current status: 5xx rate down to ~1-2%, euc2b still unstable but contained
Priya (SRE): thanks. I’ll keep a watch and update every 15m. starting incident timeline notes for postmortem.
Marta (support): copying Priya the list of high-touch customers who reported failures.
Priya (SRE): got it. filing a follow-up runbook add: when an AZ shows repeated connection resets, immediately reduce DNS weight and open cloud provider case.
Deploy Bot: Automated telemetry snapshot created: s3://redwood-incidents/2073/snapshot-20260315-1018.tar.gz
Kate (on-call): thanks everyone. closing paging for now. please @here if anything regresses.
Priya (SRE): incident marked as mitigated at 2026-03-15T10:31:40Z. will keep monitoring. postmortem owner assigned: Priya.
Marta (support): customers notified of mitigation and ongoing monitoring. will consolidate ticket list for postmortem.
Priya (SRE): postmortem draft to follow with timeline, impact calc, mitigation steps, and actionable items (ASG tuning, route53 automated failover runbook, ALB healthcheck tuning).
